all_tweets.title:
Hedera x Fireblocks is bigger than it looks.

This is not just another ecosystem listing.

Fireblock
all_tweets.description:
Hedera x Fireblocks is bigger than it looks.

This is not just another ecosystem listing.

Fireblocks is institutional digital asset infrastructure, giving enterprises secure custody, transfers, treasury operations, staking access and API-based workflows for assets like $HBAR and Hedera Token Service assets.

Why does this matter?

Institutions do not usually interact with networks the same way retail users do.

They need custody, compliance, approvals, audit trails, policy controls and secure operational infrastructure before they can move serious capital on-chain.

That is where Fireblocks comes in.

@FireblocksHQ uses MPC-based custody, which helps reduce single points of failure by splitting key management across multiple parties and systems.

For institutions, this matters because security is not optional.

Before adoption comes trust.

Before trust comes infrastructure.

@HederaFndn being supported inside Fireblocks gives institutions a cleaner path to hold, transfer and manage HBAR and Hedera-based tokens.

That includes treasury workflows, approvals, reporting and operational controls that enterprises already require.

This is how blockchain becomes usable at scale.

The important part is not only custody.

Fireblocks also provides API-first infrastructure.

That means businesses can integrate digital asset operations directly into existing systems instead of building everything from scratch.

For enterprises, simplicity is adoption fuel.

Hedera’s ecosystem page lists Fireblocks among its custodian infrastructure providers, alongside names like BitGo, Copper, Hex Trust, Ledger and Anchorage Digital.  

That matters because institutional adoption needs more than a fast network.

It needs trusted access points.

Fireblocks previously announced support for HBAR, allowing users to securely store and transfer HBAR across the Fireblocks Network.  

Hedera documentation also describes Fireblocks support for HBAR and Hedera tokens using MPC technology, transaction policy controls and custodial management.  

This fits perfectly into Hedera’s bigger positioning.

Hedera is not trying to be another retail hype chain.

It is building around enterprise use cases, tokenization, payments, real-world assets, compliance-friendly infrastructure and scalable network operations.

For HBAR, this is the type of integration that often gets underestimated.

It does not create instant price fireworks.

But it strengthens the rails.

And in digital assets, the rails usually come before the traffic.

My view:

Fireblocks gives institutions the infrastructure layer.
Hedera provides the network layer.
HBAR and HTS assets become easier to custody, move and integrate.

That is how serious adoption starts.

Quiet infrastructure first.
Visible usage later.

👉🏻 https://t.co/2UzLcDHVZR

The initial use case i
all_tweets.description:
Western Union is launching USDPT, a dollar stablecoin on Solana, next month.

The initial use case is not consumer-facing. It replaces SWIFT for settling with their global agent network, in real time, 24 hours a day, including weekends. 

Issued by Anchorage Digital Bank. Custody with U.S. Bank. A Stable Card is coming later this year for consumers in high-inflation markets.

A 175-year-old money transfer company chose Solana as its settlement layer. Not Ethereum. Not a private permissioned chain. Solana.

The institutional rails are being laid faster than the price action reflects. That gap always closes eventually, and it usually closes fast.

all_tweets.description:
Unlike older solutions that required moving to separate private blockchains, @FlutonIO  operates as a convenient layer on top of existing networks.

You continue to hold your ETH, USDC, or other assets on familiar chains Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, or Solana. There’s no need to transfer anything. A single wallet provides full privacy: your balances, swaps, and strategies remain hidden thanks to encrypted intents and FHE technology.

No liquidity fragmentation, no separate applications, and no complex migrations. Fluton simply adds a “privacy by default” mode while preserving the speed and convenience of regular DeFi. It’s a solution that finally makes privacy both practical and accessible at scale.

all_tweets.description:
Fireblocksは3年連続でMeet the CEOイベントを開催。日本の金融・デジタル資産分野のトップリーダーにお越しいただき、130名以上の方々と共にデジタルアセット戦略の最前線に焦点を当てました。
CEO Michael Shaulovは、業界を貫く3つの波を提示。第1の波「暗号資産」がグローバルな流動性の基盤を築き、第2の波「ステーブルコイン」が決済をオンチェーンへ移行させ、コストと摩擦を圧縮。第3の波「RWAトークン化」が、証券・国債・ファンドへとインフラを拡張しています。
ステーブルコイン市場は12ヶ月で$1,500億から$3,100億へ成長。月間取引量は$1.2Tから$2.5Tへ拡大。日本のオンチェーン価値受取額は前年比120%増、APACで最も高い成長率の一つです。
Panel 1：オンチェーンファイナンスとRWAの実装 磯和啓雄氏（SMFG）、和歌伸介氏（三井物産） モデレーター：牧野剛（Fireblocks）
Panel 2：日本と世界のブロックチェーン収益化 ラッセル・カマー氏（AltX Research）、ルー・イン氏（Solana Foundation）、Stephen Richardson（Fireblocks） モデレーター：ウナ・ソフティッチ氏（CoinPost）
ご登壇・ご参加いただいた全ての皆様に、心より御礼申し上げます。

all_tweets.description:

过去两年我参加过不少讨论，量子要么被当成科幻噱头，要么被一句还早带过。但 Quip 不是来吵架的，他们是带着解决方案进会场的。

我忽然想起 2017 年比特币扩容那场争论，也是 Vegas，也是这种把分歧摆上桌的架势。不同的是，这次不再争区块大小，而是争加密世界还能不能安全地活到下一个十年。不管辩论谁赢，这张议程本身，就已经赢了。

@quipnetwork  #quipnetwork #Quip

all_tweets.title:
This is a big, and I mean BIG deal. Let me explain why. 

DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution
all_tweets.description:
This is a big, and I mean BIG deal. Let me explain why. 

DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution, which is used primarily as an API product by fintech, custody and other companies that need to automate digital asset transactions. 

Up until now, they could only move money programmatically unencrypted. This means anyone onchain could see everything. This is very bad if you are building a neobank or if you are a market maker trading on open markets. 

By integrating @zama and the ERC-7984 confidential token standard, @dfnsHQ is now enabling all those customers to move money, trade and settle onchain *confidentially*, just as easily as they did before with non-confidential ERC-20 tokens. 

I am very very excited about the design space this creates, and the opportunities it unlocks. 

I'll do a much deeper post about it next week!

policy.title: Unlike older solutions that required moving to separate private blockchains, @FlutonIO  operates as
policy.description:
Unlike older solutions that required moving to separate private blockchains, @FlutonIO  operates as a convenient layer on top of existing networks.

You continue to hold your ETH, USDC, or other assets on familiar chains Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, or Solana. There’s no need to transfer anything. A single wallet provides full privacy: your balances, swaps, and strategies remain hidden thanks to encrypted intents and FHE technology.

No liquidity fragmentation, no separate applications, and no complex migrations. Fluton simply adds a “privacy by default” mode while preserving the speed and convenience of regular DeFi. It’s a solution that finally makes privacy both practical and accessible at scale.

policy.title: Have you ever been frustrated using a Web3 wallet having to figure out your USDC across 5-6 differen
policy.description:
Have you ever been frustrated using a Web3 wallet having to figure out your USDC across 5-6 different chains, needing to bridge and swap and re-balance constantly, with slippage and fees, and confusing UX?  

Have you ever thought "how will the normies every figure this out?"

We've thought about this too, A LOT.  And today we're launching the new Unified Balance Kit, and simple developer tool that allows wallet builders to offer their users a single unified USDC balance with the ability to perform nearly instant (<500ms) crosschain sends to the most popular chains.

Users get a simple UX that makes sense --- a single USDC balance, and no need to think about, understand or deal with the complexity of crosschain interactions.

These small steps are what will bring USDC into mass adoption within mainstream app and wallet experiences.

Available to start building with today.

3), a clean template for regulated issuance: the primary security lives on the @avax C-Chain while ownership records / settlement logic run on a permissioned L1, giving institutions privacy + control w/o losing interop.  

Closed bank networks becoming shared infrastructure is the structural shift here, & it's happening on @avax

Hedera x Fireblocks is bigger than it looks.

This is not just another ecosystem listing.

Fireblock
company.description:
Hedera x Fireblocks is bigger than it looks.

This is not just another ecosystem listing.

Fireblocks is institutional digital asset infrastructure, giving enterprises secure custody, transfers, treasury operations, staking access and API-based workflows for assets like $HBAR and Hedera Token Service assets.

Why does this matter?

Institutions do not usually interact with networks the same way retail users do.

They need custody, compliance, approvals, audit trails, policy controls and secure operational infrastructure before they can move serious capital on-chain.

That is where Fireblocks comes in.

@FireblocksHQ uses MPC-based custody, which helps reduce single points of failure by splitting key management across multiple parties and systems.

For institutions, this matters because security is not optional.

Before adoption comes trust.

Before trust comes infrastructure.

@HederaFndn being supported inside Fireblocks gives institutions a cleaner path to hold, transfer and manage HBAR and Hedera-based tokens.

That includes treasury workflows, approvals, reporting and operational controls that enterprises already require.

This is how blockchain becomes usable at scale.

The important part is not only custody.

Fireblocks also provides API-first infrastructure.

That means businesses can integrate digital asset operations directly into existing systems instead of building everything from scratch.

For enterprises, simplicity is adoption fuel.

Hedera’s ecosystem page lists Fireblocks among its custodian infrastructure providers, alongside names like BitGo, Copper, Hex Trust, Ledger and Anchorage Digital.  

That matters because institutional adoption needs more than a fast network.

It needs trusted access points.

Fireblocks previously announced support for HBAR, allowing users to securely store and transfer HBAR across the Fireblocks Network.  

Hedera documentation also describes Fireblocks support for HBAR and Hedera tokens using MPC technology, transaction policy controls and custodial management.  

This fits perfectly into Hedera’s bigger positioning.

Hedera is not trying to be another retail hype chain.

It is building around enterprise use cases, tokenization, payments, real-world assets, compliance-friendly infrastructure and scalable network operations.

For HBAR, this is the type of integration that often gets underestimated.

It does not create instant price fireworks.

But it strengthens the rails.

And in digital assets, the rails usually come before the traffic.

My view:

Fireblocks gives institutions the infrastructure layer.
Hedera provides the network layer.
HBAR and HTS assets become easier to custody, move and integrate.

That is how serious adoption starts.

Quiet infrastructure first.
Visible usage later.

👉🏻 https://t.co/2UzLcDHVZR

company.description:
Western Union is launching USDPT, a dollar stablecoin on Solana, next month.

The initial use case is not consumer-facing. It replaces SWIFT for settling with their global agent network, in real time, 24 hours a day, including weekends. 

Issued by Anchorage Digital Bank. Custody with U.S. Bank. A Stable Card is coming later this year for consumers in high-inflation markets.

A 175-year-old money transfer company chose Solana as its settlement layer. Not Ethereum. Not a private permissioned chain. Solana.

The institutional rails are being laid faster than the price action reflects. That gap always closes eventually, and it usually closes fast.

company.description:
Fireblocksは3年連続でMeet the CEOイベントを開催。日本の金融・デジタル資産分野のトップリーダーにお越しいただき、130名以上の方々と共にデジタルアセット戦略の最前線に焦点を当てました。
CEO Michael Shaulovは、業界を貫く3つの波を提示。第1の波「暗号資産」がグローバルな流動性の基盤を築き、第2の波「ステーブルコイン」が決済をオンチェーンへ移行させ、コストと摩擦を圧縮。第3の波「RWAトークン化」が、証券・国債・ファンドへとインフラを拡張しています。
ステーブルコイン市場は12ヶ月で$1,500億から$3,100億へ成長。月間取引量は$1.2Tから$2.5Tへ拡大。日本のオンチェーン価値受取額は前年比120%増、APACで最も高い成長率の一つです。
Panel 1：オンチェーンファイナンスとRWAの実装 磯和啓雄氏（SMFG）、和歌伸介氏（三井物産） モデレーター：牧野剛（Fireblocks）
Panel 2：日本と世界のブロックチェーン収益化 ラッセル・カマー氏（AltX Research）、ルー・イン氏（Solana Foundation）、Stephen Richardson（Fireblocks） モデレーター：ウナ・ソフティッチ氏（CoinPost）
ご登壇・ご参加いただいた全ての皆様に、心より御礼申し上げます。

company.description:
Given that noone is speaking about @flipcash even after the launch of their tg bot, let me do a quick post: 
> highly speculative, but I like going where there is some friction. 
> new payment app by the Kik founder, token launchpad integrated. 
> Has it’s own stablecoin USDF, for which an Coinbase onramp is coming, as well as USDF listings on Coinbase.
> Broader availability of USDF in the Solana ecosystem planned too. Right now switching back to classic stables comes with a shave off. 
> App is super clunky still, but how you can play it:
> If you check their app, basically I see two plays right now. 
> $moony, first utility play there. Team is linked to Flipcash team itself. 
> $jeffy, first meme there. mooned to 4M on first day, dumped to 0.2m, back to 1.1M today. 
> Very speculative, but you want to make money frontrunning attention. I barely see anything on X, so I allocated earlier this week to have some exposure. Could be nothing of course 🤷‍♂️

company.title:
This is a big, and I mean BIG deal. Let me explain why. 

DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution
company.description:
This is a big, and I mean BIG deal. Let me explain why. 

DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution, which is used primarily as an API product by fintech, custody and other companies that need to automate digital asset transactions. 

Up until now, they could only move money programmatically unencrypted. This means anyone onchain could see everything. This is very bad if you are building a neobank or if you are a market maker trading on open markets. 

By integrating @zama and the ERC-7984 confidential token standard, @dfnsHQ is now enabling all those customers to move money, trade and settle onchain *confidentially*, just as easily as they did before with non-confidential ERC-20 tokens. 

I am very very excited about the design space this creates, and the opportunities it unlocks. 

I'll do a much deeper post about it next week!
